overview: Rainbow AI is a WhatsApp AI assistant for Pelangi Capsule Hostel & Southern Homestay. It handles guest inquiries, booking workflows, and multi-turn conversations via Baileys WebSocket. The focus is on reliability, response quality, and intent classification accuracy.
goals: Improve intent classification accuracy for booking and inquiry intents
Enhance conversation context handling for multi-turn dialogues
Add better fallback responses when AI confidence is low
Improve the booking workflow steps in workflows.json
Prioritize reliability and response quality over new features
Enforce strict business profile separation — each profile's data files must only contain content specific to that business, with zero contamination from other profiles
Fix data-makan and data-southern profiles which currently contain copy-pasted Pelangi Capsule Hostel content

epics.title: Intent Classification Accuracy
epics.description: Improve how the system classifies incoming messages into the correct intent categories, especially for booking and inquiry intents.

epics.title: Multi-Turn Conversation Context
epics.description: Enhance the system's ability to track and use conversation context across multiple turns of dialogue.

epics.title: Fallback & Confidence Handling
epics.description: Improve responses when the AI has low confidence or cannot classify an intent reliably.

epics.title: Booking Workflow Improvements
epics.description: Improve the booking workflow steps, transitions, and validation logic in workflows.json and related pipeline code.

epics.title: Test Suite Reliability
epics.description: Fix failing tests and improve test coverage for core intent and conversation logic.

epics.title: Business Profile Separation
epics.description: Ensure strict data isolation between all business profiles. Each profile's data files (knowledge.json, intents.json, intent-keywords.json, routing.json, templates.json, workflows.json) must contain ONLY content specific to that business. No profile may contain identifiers, addresses, credentials, pricing, or intents belonging to a different business.

userStories.description: Automatically detect when intent classification accuracy drops unexpectedly compared to baseline and trigger admin alerts
acceptanceCriteria: Add intent_classifier_baselines table storing profile_id, intent_type, baseline_accuracy (7-day rolling), last_updated; implement migration
Add regression detection logic triggered during nightly analytics job: alert if accuracy drops >5% from baseline, create record in regression_alerts table
Implement /admin/analytics/regression-alerts endpoint returning active/resolved regressions with affected intents, baseline accuracy, and current accuracy

userStories.title: Profile-aware message routing validation middleware preventing cross-profile contamination
userStories.description: Validate that incoming messages route to correct profile and log violations to audit trail to enforce strict business profile separation
acceptanceCriteria: Add message routing validation middleware in src/assistant/pipeline/middleware/routing-validator.ts that asserts message.profile === target_profile before processing intent classification
Log all routing violations to rainbow_config_audit table with type 'cross_profile_routing', sender_id, intended_profile, actual_profile for investigation
Add src/tests/middleware/routing-validation.test.ts asserting middleware rejects messages where profile !== target and audit logs contain violation records with all required fields

userStories.title: Audit and report orphaned intent-keywords.json entries preventing keyword-based classification
userStories.description: Create CLI tool to detect keywords in intent-keywords.json that don't match any intent in intents.json, breaking intent classification for those keywords and indicating data contamination from previous profiles

CLI command: npm run audit:keywords -- --profile=makan outputs JSON report with intent_id, keyword, and suggested cleanup action for each orphaned entry
Exit with error code 1 if orphaned keywords found in production mode; used in CI/CD to prevent contaminated data from being deployed

userStories.title: Profile Data Contamination Regression Test Suite

Tests assert Makan and Pelangi intent name sets are disjoint (no overlap) by comparing intent_configs files and routing.json intent references
CI/CD blocks merge if tests fail with error listing contaminated files and offending keywords for manual remediation

userStories.title: Profile Intent Keyword Validation at Startup
userStories.description: Validate that intent-keywords.json contains only keywords for intents defined in intents.json for that profile, preventing orphaned keywords and cross-profile keyword contamination.

userStories.title: Intent Classification Escalation Queue with Low-Confidence Auto-Flagging
userStories.description: Automatically flag intent classifications with confidence < 40% for human review. Store in dedicated escalation queue with original intent, actual guest correction, and keyword improvement recommendations. Reduces fallback escalations by enabling quick manual triage.

userStories.title: Automated Booking Clarification Question Generator for Low-Confidence Intents

Clarification template library at `src/assistant/data/clarification-templates.json` includes per-profile and per-intent variants; fallback to generic template if profile-specific not found

userStories.title: Booking Workflow Step Execution Duration Histogram Endpoint
userStories.description: Add admin API endpoint that returns execution time distribution for each booking workflow step across recent bookings, enabling performance bottleneck identification and workflow optimization.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin endpoint GET /admin/analytics/workflow-durations?profile=pelangi&days=7 returns JSON with step names and execution time percentiles (p50, p95, p99)
Endpoint queries rainbow_messages table timestamps, calculates histograms per workflow step with min/max/mean durations
Unit test mocks booking execution data with step timings, asserts response includes all booking workflow step names and valid percentile calculations

Conversation pipeline in src/assistant/pipeline/context-manager.ts reads settings on startup and applies pruning before sending context to AI provider
Unit test loads settings.json with different configurations, applies pruning with various max_messages values, asserts final context respects configured window size

userStories.title: Fallback Response Suggestion Engine CLI
userStories.description: CLI tool that analyzes recent misclassified messages and generates suggestions for fallback response templates, with confidence scores and exact file paths for implementation.

Test asserts suggestions generated only for intents with >2 recent misclassifications, output includes profile validation, and suggested templates contain actionable guidance

userStories.title: Build per-profile intent accuracy baseline validator for CI regression detection

userStories.title: Guest Language Auto-Detection from First Message for Multi-Lingual Context

Unit test: assert >85% accuracy detecting Mandarin/Tamil/Malay on 50-word message samples from test/fixtures/multilingual-samples.json

userStories.title: Booking Workflow Step SLA Monitoring Endpoint for Performance Tracking

Test: assert status='critical' when avg_duration_ms exceeds sla_threshold_ms by >50%; warning when 90-150% of threshold

userStories.title: Conversation Context Span Analyzer for Multi-Turn Window Recommendations
userStories.description: Analyze conversation history to assess context quality and recommend pruning strategy. Measures message count, age of oldest message, and semantic drift to guide context window optimization for multi-turn dialogues.

Admin endpoint GET /admin/conversations/:id/context-analysis returns analysis result with actionable pruning recommendation

Add CLI command `npm run analyze-turns -- --profile pelangi --days 30` outputting CSV with intent, turn_count, conversation_count, success_rate grouped by profile

userStories.title: Fallback Response Template Staleness and Quality Auditor
userStories.description: CLI audit tool that identifies fallback response templates unchanged for >90 days or lacking helpful suggestions (action verbs, next steps). Flags templates for refresh to keep responses relevant and helpful.
